faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GMC Thiruvallur Van Driver (Contract) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the Van Driver (Contract) post at Government Medical College Thiruvallur is 28th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Van Driver (Contract) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 8th standard, possess a Heavy vehicle License, and have at least one year of experience in the driving field to be eligible for the Van Driver (Contract) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Van Driver (Contract) position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Van Driver (Contract) post is between a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 50 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Van Driver (Contract) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Van Driver (Contract) position will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 12,480/- per month. This is a fixed monthly remuneration for the contract period.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Van Driver (Contract) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Van Driver (Contract) position at Government Medical College Thiruvallur in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the GMC Thiruvallur Van Driver (Contract) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications via post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Along with the self-request letter, candidates need to submit 2 passport-size photos, photocopies of General Educational Qualification, Community Certificate, and AADHAR Card, all self-attested.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for the Van Driver (Contract) post. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Van Driver position at Government Medical College Thiruvallur is on a contract basis. This means the employment is for a fixed tenure.
